notes: How a pilot reacts under fire (simcore/reactions.hpp, reaction_chain.hpp). A cue from his own picture (eye, receiver, a call heard, his own damage), a delay by skill, the cue's source, workload and stress (tiers), a manoeuvre and a countermeasure by his faction's profile (rows), and his flight's decision drawn once by its leader: jettison anything (of those, tanks only), press on, abort; the rest goes round. Row lookup: the row for the cue's source and class, else the class with any source, else the source with any class, else the profile's fallback. Design estimates anchored as named; every share is a SAM3D estimate bounded by the counts in docs/air_battle/04_REACTIONS.md sections 4, 8 and 9.
